description: "The Chronology of Ancient Kingdoms Amended" by Isaac Newton is a work of historical chronology published posthumously in 1728. Spanning 87,000 words across six chapters, Newton examines the rise and history of ancient civilizations including Greece, Egypt, Assyria, Babylon, Media, and Persia.
